Lumenwise Privacy Policy

Effective October 9, 2026 · Last updated October 9, 2026

The short version. Your highlights, notes, prayers and questions are stored on your iPhone. There is no account and we run no server, so we never have your data. The Bible texts are built into the app, and Ask is answered by Apple's on-device AI, so your questions never leave your phone. Purchases go through Apple. The free version shows ads; the ad companies collect some device data to show them, never your reading, notes, prayers or questions, and Pro removes ads entirely.

Who we are

Lumenwise is made by an independent developer ("we", "us"). This policy covers the Lumenwise iPhone app, its widgets and its Siri and Shortcuts actions. Lumenwise is not affiliated with any church, denomination or Bible publisher. Questions: SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD.

Your data stays on your device

What you create in Lumenwise is stored in a database in the app's own private storage on your iPhone:

  • highlights, verse notes and bookmarks;
  • the reading plans you join, your progress and daily reading logs (used to count your streak);
  • prayer requests, the updates you add to them and notes on answered prayers;
  • your Ask conversations (the questions you type and the answers shown).

Your preferences are kept in the app's settings on the device: your Bible translation, reader settings (such as font, size and theme), the faith tradition you pick for Ask, your reminder time, whether the prayer journal is locked, a cached note of whether Pro is active, timestamps the app uses to space out ads, counters for rewards earned by watching a rewarded ad, and your "do not sell or share" choice.

There is no iCloud sync in this version. Nothing syncs or leaves your iPhone except what you explicitly share or export. We have no server for this data and cannot see it. Like any app's data, it is included in your own device backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup), which Apple and you control.

Ask: AI on your iPhone

  • Ask uses Apple's on-device Foundation Models, which run entirely on your iPhone. It is available on iOS 26 or later, on devices that support Apple Intelligence with Apple Intelligence turned on.
  • Your questions and the answers are never sent to us or to any third party. There is no cloud AI service and no proxy server, and Ask works in Airplane Mode.
  • Answers can only quote Bible verses that the app looks up in its built-in text, word for word (our "Verbatim-Verse Guarantee"). The explanations around those verses are generated by the on-device model and can be wrong; see the Terms of Use.
  • On devices without Apple Intelligence, Lumenwise shows study notes that are built into the app instead. Nothing is sent anywhere.
  • Your Ask history is saved on your iPhone so you can come back to it, and you can delete it at any time.

Bible texts and search

The King James Version (1769 text) and the World English Bible are built into the app, so reading works offline. Both are public domain texts from eBible.org. Searching the Bible happens on your iPhone using a local index. No network connection is used for scripture or search, and we never learn what you read or search for.

Widgets and Siri

To show widgets, Lumenwise copies a small summary into a storage area shared only with its own widgets (an App Group): the verse of the day for the next few days, the title and progress of your current reading plan, your streak count, and items for the prayer check-in widget.

  • Prayer titles appear on widgets only if you turn on "show prayer titles on widgets", which is off by default. Widgets can be seen on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, so think about who can see your phone before turning this on.
  • When you answer a prayer check-in from the interactive widget, the answer is queued in the same shared area. The app applies it to your journal the next time it opens and then clears the queue.
  • Siri and Shortcuts ("verse of the day") read only this local widget summary. Links into the app use Lumenwise's own link scheme and stay on your device.

Things you choose to share

Lumenwise never sends anything on its own. These features only share what you choose, through iOS's share sheet or the Photos app:

  • Verse cards: an image of a verse you design, shared or saved to Photos by you.
  • Sharing a verse or your plan progress, including "read together" invites for a reading plan, sent by you to someone you choose.
  • Exports of notes, highlights or your prayer journal (PDF or text). Keep these files somewhere safe; a prayer journal export contains your personal prayers.

Once you share something, the app or person you send it to handles it under their own privacy practices.

Permissions

All permissions are optional. Lumenwise works without them.

  • Notifications: a daily reading reminder, prayer check-back reminders with "Answered" and "Still praying" buttons, and a reminder 48 hours before a free trial turns into a paid subscription. All are scheduled locally on your iPhone; no notification server is used.
  • Face ID, Touch ID or passcode to lock the prayer journal. This is handled entirely by iOS. Lumenwise only learns whether unlocking succeeded and never receives biometric data.
  • Photos. To save verse cards to your library (add-only). If you pick a photo as a verse-card background, Lumenwise reads that one photo on your iPhone, uses it only to draw the card and never uploads it.
  • App Tracking Transparency: asked only in the free version, after a short explanation in the app. See Advertising.
  • Background audio: lets read-aloud keep playing when you lock your phone. Read-aloud uses Apple's on-device speech voices; the text is not sent anywhere.

Lumenwise does not ask for your location, contacts, camera, microphone or Health data.

Network connections

Lumenwise works offline. It connects to the internet only for Apple's App Store (prices, purchases, restores and subscription status), for ads in the free version, and for links you tap. Scripture, search, Ask and read-aloud never use the network. You can check this yourself in iOS's App Privacy Report (Settings > Privacy & Security > App Privacy Report).

Purchases and subscriptions

Lumenwise Pro is sold through Apple's App Store using StoreKit. Apple handles the payment, your payment details, your Apple ID and your billing address. We never see your name, email address or payment information. The app only receives a signed confirmation from Apple saying which product is active (for example, "Yearly, renews on a date" or "Lifetime") so it can unlock Pro and switch off ads. That check happens on your device. Apple's handling of purchase data is covered by Apple's Privacy Policy.

App Store Connect gives us aggregated, non-identifying sales reports (for example, how many trials started in a country). Apple does not give us your identity.

Lumenwise Pro is offered as Lumenwise Pro Yearly (an auto-renewing yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) and Lumenwise Pro Lifetime (a one-time purchase). Both support Family Sharing. You can restore purchases and manage your subscription from the app's Settings.

Advertising in the free version

The free version of Lumenwise shows ads. Buying Lumenwise Pro (a subscription or the lifetime purchase) removes all ads, and the ad SDK then stops requesting ads.

Ads are delivered by AppLovin MAX, an ad mediation SDK built into the app. MAX may fill an ad slot from AppLovin itself or from other ad networks it mediates, such as Google AdMob. These companies, not us, receive and process the data described below. We do not receive it in a form that identifies you; we only see aggregated reports such as how many ads were shown and how much they earned.

What the ad SDKs may collect

DataWhenUsed for
Advertising identifier (IDFA)Only if you tap "Allow" on Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. If you choose "Ask App Not to Track", iOS gives the SDK an all-zeros identifier instead.Personalized ads, measuring ads across apps (tracking)
Identifier for Vendor (IDFV) and SDK-generated IDsWhenever an ad is requestedFrequency capping, fraud prevention, reporting; not linked across companies' apps without your permission
IP address and approximate (coarse) location derived from itWhenever an ad is requestedDelivering ads, picking the right language/region, legal compliance (for example, privacy rules by region), fraud prevention
Device and app information: device model, iOS version, language, time zone, screen size, network type, carrier, app name and versionWhenever an ad is requestedShowing ads that fit your device, troubleshooting, fraud prevention
Ad interaction data: which ads were shown, taps, video completions, rewarded-ad completionsWhen you see or interact with an adAd delivery, measurement, billing between ad companies, rewarding you for a rewarded ad
Ad SDK diagnostics (crash and performance data about the ad SDK)If the ad SDK has a problemKeeping the ad SDK working

Ad SDKs never get access to what you read or search for, your highlights, notes, bookmarks, reading plans, prayers, the questions you ask or the answers you get, or the faith tradition you choose. That information stays on your iPhone, is never shared with ad partners or anyone else, and is never used to choose which ads you see. As with any app that shows ads, an ad request does tell the ad network which app it came from (Lumenwise).

The app does not request precise location for ads and does not give ad SDKs access to your contacts, camera, microphone or Health data.

Your ad choices

  • App Tracking Transparency (all users). The first time ads might be personalized, the app explains why and then shows Apple's prompt. Choose "Ask App Not to Track" and the ad SDKs cannot use your IDFA or track you across other companies' apps and websites; you will still see ads, but they are non-personalized or based on the content of the app. You can change this at any time in iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking (per app, or turn off "Allow Apps to Request to Track" for every app).
  • In-app consent manager (EEA, UK and Switzerland). Where the law requires it, a consent screen (Google's User Messaging Platform, shown through AppLovin MAX) asks before any data is used for personalized ads, and lets you accept, reject or pick partners and purposes. You can reopen it at any time from Lumenwise Settings > Ad Privacy Choices to change or withdraw your consent.
  • Remove ads entirely by buying Lumenwise Pro. A subscription or lifetime purchase turns off all ads.
  • Limit ad personalization at the partner. Google: My Ad Center.

Ad partners and their privacy policies

  • AppLovin (MAX mediation and AppLovin ads): applovin.com/privacy
  • Google AdMob: Google Privacy Policy and How Google uses information from apps that use its services

We may add or remove mediated ad networks over time. When we add one, we will list it here and update the changelog at the bottom of this page. The full, current list of partners and purposes is also shown in the consent screen where that screen applies.

"Do not sell or share my personal information"

Lumenwise Settings > Ad Privacy Choices also has a "Do not sell or share my personal information" switch. When it is on, Lumenwise tells AppLovin, and through it the networks it mediates, not to sell or share your personal information for targeted advertising, as US state privacy laws allow. Your choice is stored on your device.

When ads start, and where they appear

  • No ad SDK starts until you have finished onboarding and, where they apply, seen the tracking explanation, Apple's tracking prompt and the consent screen. Google's ad measurement is also set to wait until then.
  • Your IDFA is used only if you choose "Allow" on Apple's tracking prompt. Otherwise ads are non-personalized.
  • Banner ads appear only on the Plans list and in Search results. There is at most one full-screen ad per session, and only after you complete a plan day. Watching a rewarded ad (for example, for extra Ask questions or to try a reading plan) is always your choice.
  • Ads never appear in the Bible reader text, the prayer journal, Ask, onboarding, the Pro screen, Today or verse cards.
  • With Pro (subscription or lifetime), the ad SDK is never started: no tracking prompt, no consent screen and no ads.

We ask our ad partners to block ads for gambling, dating, alcohol and mature content where their controls allow it. If you see an inappropriate ad in Lumenwise, please tell us at SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD.

Religious beliefs and sensitive information

What you read, highlight, pray about and ask can reveal religious or philosophical beliefs, which many privacy laws treat as sensitive. That is why it never leaves your control: it stays on your iPhone, it is not sent to us, it is not shared with ad partners or anyone else, and it is not used for advertising, profiling or research. The faith tradition you pick for Ask only changes how answers are worded on your device.

What we never do

  • No account, sign-in or email address needed.
  • No server holding your data, no cloud AI, and no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs of our own. (Ad SDKs may report their own diagnostics, as described above.)
  • We never sell your data and never use your reading, notes, prayers or questions for advertising.
  • This version of Lumenwise does not use iCloud or CloudKit, Apple Health or Spotlight indexing.

Data retention

  • On-device data is kept until you delete it (individual items, deleting all data in Settings, or deleting the app). We keep no copy.
  • Ad data is retained by AppLovin, Google and other ad partners according to their policies linked above.
  • Purchase records are kept by Apple under Apple's policies.
  • Support emails are kept only as long as needed to help you and keep a record of the conversation, then deleted, normally within 24 months. Ask us to delete them sooner at any time.

Exporting and deleting your data

  • Export: you can export your prayer journal, and with Pro your notes and highlights, as PDF or text.
  • Delete single items: highlights, notes, bookmarks, prayers and Ask conversations can each be deleted where they are listed.
  • Delete everything: the Privacy section of Lumenwise Settings has an option to delete all your data, with a confirmation. It erases your Lumenwise data, scheduled reminders and widget content on this iPhone and can't be undone.
  • Deleting the app removes all its on-device data, including the widget summary. It does not cancel a subscription.
  • Ad data: use your ad choices or contact the ad partner; email us and we'll help.

Your privacy rights

Because Lumenwise has no account and no server, we do not hold a profile about you. Your app data is on your device, where you can view, export (where the app offers it) and delete it yourself. For data the ad partners collect, you can use the choices above or contact the partner directly. Whatever your location, you can email us and we will help.

EEA, UK and Switzerland (GDPR / UK GDPR)

  • Who is responsible. We, the developer of Lumenwise, are the controller for the limited personal data we handle (for example, emails you send us, and the decision to integrate ad SDKs). AppLovin, Google and other ad partners act as independent controllers for the data they collect to deliver and measure ads.
  • Legal bases. Personalized ads and the access to device identifiers they need: your consent, collected through the consent screen and Apple's tracking prompt. Showing non-personalized ads, frequency capping, fraud prevention and security: the legitimate interests of the developer of Lumenwise and the ad partners in funding a free app and keeping ads safe. Replying to your support email: our legitimate interest in helping you (or steps you ask for before a contract). Purchases: handled by Apple under Apple's terms.
  • Your rights. Access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection (including to processing based on legitimate interests), data portability, and withdrawing consent at any time without affecting earlier processing. Withdraw ad consent in Lumenwise Settings > Ad Privacy Choices; object or ask about anything else by emailing SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD.
  • Complaints. You can complain to your local data protection authority. We would appreciate the chance to fix things first.
  • International transfers. Ad partners may process data in the United States and other countries. They rely on safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and, where they are certified, the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework; see their policies above.

California and other US states (CCPA / CPRA and similar laws)

  • Categories collected in the last 12 months (by ad partners through the free version only): identifiers (IDFA with your permission, IDFV, SDK IDs, IP address); internet or other electronic network activity (ad impressions and taps); approximate geolocation derived from IP; device information. Inferences may be drawn by ad partners for personalized ads if you allow it. We do not collect sensitive personal information, and your in-app data is never shared with ad partners.
  • Sources and purposes. Collected directly from your device by the ad SDKs, for the advertising, measurement, security and fraud-prevention purposes described above.
  • "Sale" and "sharing". We do not sell personal information for money. Letting ad partners use identifiers for cross-context behavioral advertising may count as "selling" or "sharing" under California law. To opt out: choose "Ask App Not to Track", and/or open Lumenwise Settings > Ad Privacy Choices and opt out of sale/sharing, or email us. You can also buy Pro to remove ads entirely.
  • Your rights. To know/access, delete, correct, opt out of sale or sharing, and limit the use of sensitive personal information (we do not use any). We will not discriminate against you for using these rights; the free version stays the same whether or not you opt out. An authorized agent may make a request on your behalf with your written permission. Because we hold no account data, we may not be able to link ad-partner data to you; we will tell you which partner to contact and how.
  • Retention. See Data retention.
  • Minors. We do not knowingly sell or share the personal information of consumers under 16.

Residents of other US states with consumer privacy laws (for example Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Texas and Oregon) have similar rights to access, delete, correct and opt out of targeted advertising. Use the same steps above or email us. If we decline a request, you can appeal by replying to our answer with "Appeal" in the subject line.

Children

Lumenwise is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country). If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, for example by email, contact us and we will delete it.

Security

Your data is protected by iOS app sandboxing and Data Protection encryption, and you can lock the prayer journal with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. Because we don't operate a server, there is no developer-held database of your notes, prayers or questions that could be breached. Keep your device passcode, your Apple ID and any exported files secure.

Contact

Email SUPPORT_EMAIL_TBD for questions, privacy requests or complaints. If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you write, and use it only to reply; please don't include prayer details or other personal information we don't need. We aim to answer within 7 days, and privacy requests within the time the law requires (30 days under GDPR, 45 days under CCPA).

Changes and changelog

If we change how Lumenwise handles data, for example if we add iCloud sync, we will update this page and the date at the top before the change takes effect, and for significant changes we will tell you in the app. The App Store privacy label is kept in line with this page.
